name: Mento Japanese Yen
oneLiner: JPYm is Mento's CDP-backed yen stablecoin, minted against USDm collateral via the Mento FX system on Celo with on-chain reserve and oracle pricing.
collateral: Mento CDP debt backed by USDm collateral, with live collateral and debt rows exposed by the Mento reserve dashboard API
pegMechanism: CDP-backed Mento FX stablecoin: borrowers mint JPYm against USDm collateral, while repayment/redemption mechanics and oracle pricing route value back through the Mento system

mintAuthority.summary: JPYm is minted CDP-style via immutable BorrowerOperations on Celo; token owner on both Celo and Monad is the same 4/6 Mento Safe (Celo) / 4/7 Safe (Monad) at 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 with no modules or guard.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: JPYm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 impl and admin slots zero — immutable, no upgrade path.

controls.label: Mento JPYm token owner Safe (Celo)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, JPYm owner() = 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458; Celo Safe API returned threshold 4, 6 owners (drift from prior 7 — one signer removed), no modules, zero guard. signerCount updated from 7 to 6.

controls.label: Mento JPYm token owner Safe (Monad)
controls.evidence: At Monad block 80607801, JPYm Monad (0x22f6a6752800eab67b84748fefc3cc658384af72) owner() = 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458; proxy admin (0xe4256e2d1a73510b72886e08afb0fc7651303016) owner = same Safe; Monad Safe API returned threshold 4, 7 owners, no modules, zero guard.

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577 and Monad block 80607801: JPYm owner on both chains = Safe 0x58099B...; Celo Safe now 4/6 (one signer rotated out since prior review); Monad Safe 4/7; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable on Celo. Monad proxy admin owned by same Safe. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed on both chains.

oracleRisk.summary: JPYm's sole Celo CDP branch prices its USDm collateral through Mento's onchain SortedOracles median and BreakerBox controls; an invalid rate permanently shuts down borrowing rather than switching to another provider.

branchApplicability.rationale: Mento's current deployment registry exposes one JPYm Liquity V2 branch backed by USDm, with one Trove Manager, Stability Pool, FXPriceFeed, and parameter set. No additional JPYm collateral branch appears in the registry.

branches.label: Mento JPYm / USDm branch
branches.summary: The live JPYm branch uses a one-reporter Mento SortedOracles JPY/USD feed with a five-minute report-expiry bound, a 110% MCR, Stability Pool offset, and active-Trove redistribution.

feeds.path: Mento JPY/USD SortedOracles rate (inverted) -> OracleAdapter and BreakerBox validation -> FXPriceFeed -> USDm-backed JPYm Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: FXPriceFeed reads the inverted JPY/USD rate through Mento's OracleAdapter. At Celo block 72133274 the adapter reported one live oracle report, a valid bidirectional trading mode, and a five-minute expiry; there is no alternate provider path. An invalid oracle rate invokes the branch's permanent oracle-failure shutdown path.

collateralParameters.note: The live SystemParams proxy returned MCR 110%, CCR 135%, and SCR 110%; TroveManager shutdownTime was zero at Celo block 72133274.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can batch-liquidate eligible USDm-backed JPYm Troves below the 110% MCR. The Stability Pool offsets available debt and receives collateral; uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed to active Troves.
branches.backstop: The JPYm Stability Pool is the first liquidation backstop. Debt beyond available pool JPYm is redistributed with collateral across active Troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Oracle validation failure or a branch TCR at the 110% SCR permanently shuts down new borrowing. Shutdown enables urgent redemption, while liquidation debt not offset by the Stability Pool is redistributed to active Troves.
